sentence: This project tries to find out which host factors help a virus that causes lifelong infection keep its genome inside infected cells.
This project builds methods that use deep learning to predict the impact of genetic variants on phenotypes.
This project studies the structures and biochemical properties of proteins that are targets for Alzheimer's disease drugs.
This project builds computational methods that use machine learning to study how enhancers control gene transcription in human diseases.
This project builds a statistical and computational framework that predicts how intracranial aneurysms grow over time.
This project uses PET imaging and plasma biomarker assays to study how tau and amyloid pathology develops over time in aging and Alzheimer's disease.
This project provides technologies that measure environmental toxicants and their effects on the proteome, metabolome, epigenome and genome of exposed populations.
This project tries to find out which mechanisms support nicotine relapse and tobacco addiction in the habenulo-interpeduncular system.
This project studies how melatonin regulates synaptic transmission and sleep through a channel and how a molecular pathway controls that channel.
This project uses statistical and machine learning methods to study how fine particulate matter air pollution relates to differences in cardiovascular disease outcomes.
This project builds a self-amplifying RNA vaccine against influenza that uses a catalytic RNA and modified nucleotides.
This project uses natural language processing to study online posts and discussions to find what people are unsure about regarding pre-exposure prophylaxis.
This project develops proteins and enzymes that switch on and off when they bind specific DNA or RNA sequences.
This project studies how DNA and histone methylation silence transposable elements and support growth and genome stability at high temperatures in a fungal pathogen.
This project develops technologies that analyze proteins, lipids and metabolites.
This project uses pain-induction tasks and smartphone surveys to study how age changes the link between pain and alcohol use.
This project builds a droplet acoustofluidic platform that automates liquid handling and monitoring.
This project studies how intact virus particles disassemble when they meet host cell receptors to release the viral genome.
This project studies how T cells recognize and respond to antigen from a periodontal pathogen.
This project studies how infection and drug treatment change how adipose tissue and adipose stem cells work in rhesus macaques.
